ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert cell masks to polylines with MobileSAM"
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--weights_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to MobileSAM weights"
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--output_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Output folder (or .csv file path)",
    )
    ap.add_argument("--rgb_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to RGB image")
    ap.add_argument("--csv_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to metadata csv")
    ap.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=32)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    torch.set_grad_enabled(False)
    device = "cpu"
